hypothesis: The linear expectation family incorrectly treated the entire expected adverse path as a deduction from horizon return, leaving most capital idle. Shock-only and permanent-cushion protection sacrifice too much trend participation. Use a different supervised architecture: forecast medium-horizon return for ranking, forecast near-horizon loss probability for protection, and never subtract a worst-path loss from expected return as an entry gate.
features: The independently written14causal return, trend, downside-volatility, relative-volume, close-location, drawdown and supplied-universe breadth features in expectation.py. No stock codes, sector IDs, calendar dates, excluded quotes, future standardization, external prices or reference-strategy outputs.

models.return: HistGradientBoostingRegressor; log close[t+h]/open[t+1], only labels whose h-session path has fully matured by fit date
models.tail: HistGradientBoostingClassifier; indicator that next5closing prices fall at least8% below next opening price, only fully matured five-session paths
models.fitting: Every10sessions, at most504distinct feature dates, at least40distinct mature dates. Equal aggregate weight per date before120-session half-life weighting; total sample weight equals distinct date count. No random validation split or early stopping. If only one tail class exists use its smoothed empirical frequency, not fabricated classifier certainty. Warm-up uses causal average momentum, rescaled to horizon, and tail prior0.1.
models.dependency: Research-only scikit-learn1.8.0, SciPy1.17.0, joblib1.5.3, threadpoolctl3.6.0; NumPy2.3.5/pandas2.2.3. Fit receipts include coefficient/tree hashes, mature-label endpoints and runtime versions. This dependency is not a new production default.

ownership.entry: At least20quoted sessions; predicted return>0.005, positive5-session price return and close aboveEMA20. Tail probability below candidate threshold. Allocate actual cash to top expected-return vacancies, cap60% per new name,80% drift, singleton100%.
ownership.holding: Retain actual funded units, not target equal weights. Replace only every20sessions if rank>twice capacity and strongest eligible challenger return exceeds incumbent by25%.
ownership.exit: Tail probability>=threshold together with a negative latest daily return; or predicted return<-0.02 for three closes and price belowEMA60; or single observed daily stock loss>=8%; or stale quote. No invented intraday stops, no14% fixed trailing stop and no permanent-equity recovery veto. Full exits latch until actual liquidation.
ownership.readmission: After actual exit, three fresh closes aboveEMA10 and tail probability below half the threshold; count only post-liquidation closes. All entry conditions must also hold. No new purchases while any protective exit is pending.

selection_rule: Same necessary incumbent wealth/drawdown/fill nonregression screen, otherwise minimize worst normalized deficit then original mean relative-passive-return/risk/turnover objective. Preserve all eight candidates. Already observed2026 remains retrospective; no superiority or independent holdout claim from model fitting.
execution: Unchanged independent cash-funded next-open engine and fixed market snapshot, costs, lots, prior-liquidity, limits and T+1. Do not change original economic targets, metrics, evidence status or comparison scope.
